units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 1:6">Kidd. I, 6</cite> <he>כיון … זה בחֲלִיפָיו</he> as soon as one of the parties to the exchange has taken possession, the other takes the risk for its exchange.
Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ, a. e. יש להן ח׳ can be replaced; a. fr.—Esp. ḥălifin, a form of possession by handing to the purchaser an object as a symbolical substitute (v.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 22b:9">Kidd. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>אף כח׳</he> a slave, may be taken possession of also by symbol.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 45b:11">B. Mets. 45ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אין מטבע נעשה ח׳</he> coins cannot be used for symbolical delivery; a. fr.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 2:1">Tosef. B. Kam. II, 1</cite> (Y. ib. 3ᵃ top <cite ref="H00786"><he>חִילְפִין</he></cite>).
